statements.status_notes: Fixed in simple-git 4.0.0 and later. Bumping to 4.x in the frontend lockfile breaks Nuxt generate in this build pipeline, so the override cannot land until the toolchain accepts simple-git 4.x ESM exports.

Fixed in simple-git 4.0.0 and later. Bumping to 4.x in the frontend lockfile breaks Nuxt generate in this build pipeline, so the override cannot land until the toolchain accepts simple-git 4.x ESM exports.

GitHub Advisories require simple-git 4.0.1 or newer, but that major line breaks this image's Nuxt-based frontend build (missing default export from simple-git/dist/index.mjs during generate). The runtime image ships static UI assets only; remediation depends on an upstream-compatible simple-git 4.x adoption path or a Nuxt/toolchain update.
